speaker: A
text: We have to renegotiate our trade deals, and we have to stop these countries from stealing our companies and our jobs.

speaker: A
text: Our manufacturing jobs have gone down by more than seventy thousand factories since China joined the World Trade Organization.

speaker: A
text: Unemployment in this country is far higher than the official number, and everybody knows it.

speaker: MOD
text: Secretary, would you like to respond?

speaker: B
text: Well, I think trade is an important issue. We are five percent of the world's population, so we have to trade with the other ninety five percent.

speaker: B
text: And the plan that has been put forth would be trickle-down economics all over again, with the biggest tax cuts for the top one percent we have ever had.

speaker: B
text: The economy added more than fourteen million private sector jobs over the last seven years.

speaker: MOD
text: Let's move to the next segment.

speaker: A
text: I will bring back jobs. You can't bring back jobs.
